method.interpretation: JLC reserves some inventory for SMT orders. Zero pre-purchase availability does not establish zero assembly stock. Positive stock does not reserve parts or certify an actual BOM upload.
method.snapshot_policy: Each part retains acquisition timestamp, original URL, raw HTML SHA256 and sanitized snapshot. Dynamic stock must be checked again at release.
method.pricing: USD public component tiers, fitted quantities only. No attrition, feeder/setup/handling, assembly, boards, panels, connectors, shipping or tax included.
method.quantity_policy: 100 complete modules is a supply screening scenario; 10 modules is a pricing example. Neither is an authorized purchase quantity.
method.cache_conflict: Some search snippets reported older stocks or a fixture requirement. Fresh saved public HTML governs this snapshot. No inference that assembly fees are zero from metadata specialComponentFee=0.

selected_core_component_subtotals_usd.scope: Only the selected ICs, 8 LEDs, 2 reverse diodes, clamp, NPN and Würth inductor. All resistors/capacitors, I/O, harness and manufacturing excluded.

latch_enable_revision.logic: MCU high enables LEDs through NPN pulling EN low. Reset/MCU unpowered => Q1 off, 5V pull-up disables LEDs. No direct5V pull-up on a MCU pin.
latch_enable_revision.calculations: At3.3V, assumeVBE0.7V: base series current260uA, minus7uA in100k base resistor =>253uA. Collector pull-up current<=50uA at5V, plus EN input leakage max0.5uA. This heavily overdrives the NPN; VCEsat spec0.3V at50mA/5mA is below TI minimum EN transition0.66V. Exact low-current/cold behavior remains a normal circuit review item, not a claim of measured behavior.
latch_enable_revision.rejected_MOS_reason: JSCJ2N7002 C8545 is Basic and plentiful, but RDSon is only specified at5V/10V. Using threshold alone to assert3.3V drive margin is unnecessary here.

current_limit.basis: TI TPS255xx equations with resistor corners; calculated, not measured

latch_enable_revision.fault_behavior: Keep -1 latch-off suffix; latch after overcurrent deglitch, report FAULT, do not repeatedly auto-retry. Hardware rail-current limit is not a PETG temperature limit.

retained_decisions.MCU: KeepG03164KB/8KB64MHz with existing pin plan and SWD. C03132KB/12KB48MHz costs less but needs explicit firmware clock/ADC/pin review and has lower stock. No automatic footprint/pin-equivalence claim.
retained_decisions.translator: KeepSN74LVC2T45 with VCCA=3V3,VCCB=switchedVLED,DIR=AtoB. Its Ioff/rail isolation makes it useful for either two4-pixel channels or one8-pixel chain. Do not replace with a single-supply buffer merely on nominal VIH; the checked SN74LV1T34 did not provide a clear Ioff guarantee.
retained_decisions.opamp: KeepOPA197. TLV171 has lower idle current but costs more and has only303stock in this snapshot.
retained_decisions.LED: Keep2020V6: thin package, extensive stock, lower unit cost than3535MINI. Its explicit StandardOnly/High assembly difficulty flag applies even if FR4 board dimensions meet Economic geometry limits.
retained_decisions.geometry: Current audit does not freeze one double-sided rigid strip versus two identical single-sided rigid leaves. Both retain8pixels; two data channels already supported. The same electronic designs should serve2HP and3HP, subject to final mechanical placement.
retained_decisions.prototype: Complete integrated prototype first. No separate optical coupon PCB order is a prerequisite.

baseline.comment: Keep existing low-profile geometry. Manufacturer Rev003.000 overrides old JLC table values;10%L-drop current2.45A,30%L-drop current5.4A are different criteria.

candidate_4p7_3mm.comment: Sunlord specifies30%L-drop at20C.2.9Aminimum is belowAP63205peaklimit3.1Amax. Cannot treat3.2Atyp as guaranteed fault margin.

candidate_2p2_3mm.comment: Substantially better saturation margin; deliberate inductance change. AP63205 permits nominal2.2–10uH; recalculate ripple/current/EMI, use actual capacitor DC-bias and final layout. Not a drop-in.

candidate_4p7_2mm.comment: Stock/price verified. Technical values here remain supplier-listed; exact manufacturer limits not fully retrieved. Fault margin vs3.1Amax buck limit and actual land pattern unresolved.

electrical_calculation.comment: Ideal CCM estimates; at lower load converter behavior differs. Not simulated/measured. Evaluate minimumL, minimumfrequency, input/output tolerances and DCM separately.

inductor_comparison.mechanical_correction: A3 contains2.0mm inductor body +0.1mm solder, not a3.4mm free-height allowance. ProposedA4 controllerfrontZ12.3 plus1.6mmPCB puts its rear atZ13.9. The retainedWurth2.1mm mounted envelope reachesZ16.0: root proposes moving LEDboard fromZ16..26 toZ17..27 for1mmnominal separation. A3 component dimensions are retained, butA4 fullCAD is unverified. A3.1mm mounted SWPA reachesZ17.0 and would need LEDboardZ18..28 or another relocation; this is a distinct mechanical and electrical option.
inductor_comparison.decision: KeepWurthbaseline; recordSWPA2.2uH as cost alternative only if revised placement and converter review accept it.

protection_comparison.rail_diodes: FinalA4baseline retains2xPMEG4010CEJ,115C50704:14,151stock/14,038pre-purchase atobserved2026-11-06T05:18:05JST, sufficientfor200fitteddiodesin100modulesbeforeattrition. ManufacturerIRmax50uA@40V25C; VFmax570mV@1A25C. BasicB5819W SLC8598 is only a cost-review candidate: SOD123 replacesSOD323F; maxbody/lead3.85x1.70x1.25mm andIRmax1mA@40V25C are material differences.40V/1A nominal ratings alone do not prove reverse-connection protection for a dual-rail opamp.
protection_comparison.clamp: ChooseDiodesBAS70-04-7-F C134375 as the exact candidate replacing an unspecifiedNexperiafamily. ManufacturerIRmax100nA@50V25C andVFmax410mV@1mA25C are confirmed. These do not guarantee ADCpin>-0.3V at cold/fault; final clamp/poweroff/injection/rail-backfeed review remains open.
protection_comparison.unchanged_cv: KeepdirectpassiveTHRU and20Mnominalpickup. A3VADC=V3V3/2+CV/8, not the earlierA2CV/4. Basic1%82knetwork and calibration are root passive audit decisions.

2020_V6.notes: 12mA/channel reference;8pixels full-white reference288mA/1.44W at5V, not a guaranteed current maximum.20%firmware limit≈57.6mA LEDreference, but faults can exceed that.8bit20%ceiling gives codes0..51, so low fade smoothness must be assessed.

MINI_V6.notes: OfficialV1.3drawing inspected. Larger/thicker and slightly more expensive. Does not make Economic assembly available.

LED_comparison.FPC: TransparentPET bare fabrication and domestic low-temperature process references do not by themselves establish international JLCPCB PCBA support for this exact substrate/LED combination. RigidFR4 removes that substrate qualification uncertainty, not part-specific assembly flags.

remaining_release_gates: Choose rigid lighting-board construction and routable controller placement with the newly selected jack/toggle/harness, using actual footprints.
Create native schematic and layout; runERC/DRC and verify BOM/CPL orientation. This audit is not a manufacturing package.
Close ADCnegative clamp/injection, poweroff/backfeed, reverse-rail and fuse/surge behavior; no blanket protection claim yet.
Review buck effective capacitance, hot-loop layout, startup/inrush and LED latch behavior; any cheaper inductor requires the listed electrical and mechanical redesign.
Recheck JLC BOM matched MPNs/stock, StandardOnly LED processing, panel rails/fiducials, moisture handling, attrition and final quote before ordering.
Test the complete integrated module after assembly, including all-white thermal fault case, low-brightness fade, CV range, passiveTHRU, startup/reset and cable polarity.
